teaser: A half-built shelf holds four finished brackets and one unfinished leg. Life path 4 is the Builder, laying foundation after foundation; ENTP is the Debater, restless for the next unsolved question. Put the two in one person and the contradiction is the point: a mind that wants six projects running at once, housed inside a path that measures worth by what actually stands. The tension is not a flaw to fix. It is the whole shape of the thing, visible in how a garage fills with starts and only some of them get walls.
